data.text: Before we choose this month, how about we each stick to 10 pallets? That earns each of us $10,000 and leaves the river 50% clean before recovery, so it returns to 100% for next month. My family taught me this trade, and I want our village to keep both its livelihoods and its river. We can review the revealed production figures together each month and see whether everyone kept the agreement. John, would you be willing to commit to 10?
